user.title: Add a lighting curve
user.description: Name the schedule, then choose lights in its options. Add the Lighting Curves card to a dashboard to edit the curve.

abort.already_configured: A schedule with this name already exists. Add the Lighting Curves card to a dashboard to edit its curve.

create_entry.created: Schedule created. Choose lights in its options, then add the Lighting Curves card to a dashboard to edit the curve.

init.title: Light control
init.description: Adding lights moves them from other Lighting Curves schedules. Lights follow the curve while on. Manual changes pause adaptation until off/on or the timeout (0 disables it). Add the Lighting Curves card to a dashboard to edit the curve.

data_description.separate_turn_on: For lights that stay dark when a turn-on also sets brightness or colour. Turn on plain, then apply the curve with the turn-on transition.
data_description.turn_on_floor: With separate turn-on: before a light turns off, dim it to this level, so the next turn-on starts here. Skipped while Curve Active is off.

create_schedule.name: Create schedule
create_schedule.description: Create a schedule with a default curve and no lights. Requires an administrator. Returns entry_id when a response is requested.

name.name: Name
name.description: A nonempty schedule name, unique ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

set_points.name: Set points
set_points.description: Replace the entire curve. Requires an administrator. Preserves lights and control options.

points.name: Points
points.description: Nonempty array of time, brightness (1–100) and either color_temp_kelvin (1000–10000) or rgb_color ([0–255, 0–255, 0–255]). See docs/api.md.

set_lights.name: Set lights
set_lights.description: Replace all assigned lights, moving them from other Lighting Curves schedules. Requires an administrator. An empty list removes all lights.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Existing light entities. Unavailable lights may be assigned.

get_schedules.name: Get schedules
get_schedules.description: Return loaded schedules, points, resolved times, lights, target, options and preview state. A response is required.

entry_id.name: Schedule
entry_id.description: Optional loaded schedule; omit to return all loaded schedules.

not_found.message: No loaded Lighting Curves schedule with that entry_id.
